##### Project general facts

The first premium hotel within the Royal Oasis Collection
- Pererenan (Canggu) — one of Bali's most dynamic and fast-growing areas
- 80% construction completed — project completion in June 2026
- Rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views of Canggu
- Infrastructure: rooftop lounge, sky fitness area, swimming pool, coworking space, and concierge service
- Exclusive NEXA × True Real Estate offer: apartment purchase with an installment plan and the opportunity to generate income during the payment period

Royal Oasis Collection is a premium project by NEXA — an award-winning developer with 19,667 m² built across Bali over six years, a 9.2 Booking.com rating, and recognition at Asia Pacific Property Awards and Luxury Lifestyle Awards. The project combines eco-friendly architecture inspired by Singapore's Parkroyal Collection with five-star hotel service. With a 30-year leasehold plus a guaranteed 20-year extension, spacious 41.9–44.9 m² apartments from $120,000 ($2,783/m²), this is a strong entry point into Canggu's premium segment.

Residents enjoy a world-class lifestyle ecosystem managed by AUMANA: a rooftop infinity pool with panoramic Canggu views, a rooftop lounge, sky fitness area, creative coworking space, café-restaurant, bar, private terraces, a garden, and 24/7 concierge and reception service. Unique stargazing evenings with astronomers turn ordinary nights into unforgettable experiences. The exclusive installment program offers a 30/30/30/10 payment split — with the key advantage of generating income from the apartment while still paying, a rare structure in the premium segment.

Every residence features soaring ceilings for optimal microclimate, Italian veneer finishes, premium MDF furniture, granite countertops, fully equipped kitchens with powerful ventilation and BLUM soft-close hardware, double-glazed UPVC windows for maximum soundproofing, TOTO sanitary ware, and King Koil mattresses with high-thread-count breathable bedding. Units are available across two blocks with garden, rice field, mountain, and ocean views — from $120,000 (Block 1, garden view) to $135,000 (ocean or mountain view).

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the Pererenan area of Canggu, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali’s most dynamic and rapidly growing coastal communities. Pererenan has been recognized as one of the top three most atmospheric places in the world by a renowned international publication. The area features modern, wide roads with comfortable pavements, traffic-free streets, and the best restaurants and shops within walking distance, offering a perfect blend of convenience and charm.

The location is distinguished by its strong investment fundamentals and lifestyle appeal. Annual tourist growth in the area creates high and stable demand for luxury property rentals. The premium audience is growing significantly each year, increasing demand for long-term rentals with high yields. Over recent years, property prices have appreciated substantially, with further growth potential in a limited-supply environment. Property maintenance costs remain low compared to other premium destinations.

For those seeking a residence that embodies sophistication, nature, and strong returns, Pererenan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, world-class beach clubs, renowned restaurants, and wellness facilities makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, vibrant, serene and effortlessly connected.
